requirement_text: User shall be able to retrieve the correct genre from their title or from a list of genres.
user_story: As a user, I want to find the right genre from a title or from a list of genres, so that I can classify an item quickly.
technical_task: Provide a genre lookup that works from a title and from a list of genres.
acceptance_criteria: Given a title, when the user searches, then the matching genre is returned.
Given the list of genres, when the user selects one, then that genre is retrieved.

requirement_text: The supplier shall agree to all details of component styling after awarding of contract.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to agree every detail of the component styling once the contract is awarded, so that the styling matches my expectations.
technical_task: Have the supplier agree all details of the component styling after the contract has been awarded.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contract has been awarded, when the supplier prepares the styling, then all details are agreed.
Given the agreed styling details, when they are checked, then none are left open.
rationale: Role assumed: client. The party the supplier agrees with is not named.

requirement_text: User shall have ALFRED encourage real interaction between users and not just ICT tools.
user_story: As a user, I want ALFRED to encourage real interaction between users and not only through ICT tools, so that I connect with other people.
technical_task: Design ALFRED so that it encourages real interaction between users in addition to ICT tools.
acceptance_criteria: Given ALFRED is in use, when users engage with it, then it encourages real interaction between users.
Given the interaction features, when they are reviewed, then they do not rely only on ICT tools.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How interaction is encouraged is not stated.

requirement_text: The client can register themselves in the system by filling in the required data.
user_story: As a client, I want to register myself by filling in the required data, so that I can use the system.
technical_task: Provide a self-registration form that asks for the required data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the client fills in all the required data and submits, then the client is registered.
Given the registration form, when required data is missing, then registration is not completed.
rationale: Role stated: client. The required data fields are not listed.

requirement_text: Authenticated users can add properties to the system.
user_story: As an authenticated user, I want to add properties to the system, so that they are listed.
technical_task: Let authenticated users add properties.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated user, when the user adds a property, then it is stored in the system.
Given a user who is not authenticated, when the user tries to add a property, then it is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the site on all electronic devices.
user_story: As a user, I want to open the site on any electronic device, so that I am not tied to one device.
technical_task: Make the site accessible from all electronic devices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a desktop computer, a tablet or a phone, when the user opens the site, then it loads and can be used.
Given a different screen size, when the site is displayed, then its content stays usable.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The list of devices is an interpretation of "all electronic devices".

requirement_text: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall not impact the FTSS software (i.e., the FTSS ICP load will not be different).
requirement_text_raw: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall (3.3.14.1) not impact the FTSS software (i.e., the FTSS ICP load will not be different).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS ICP load unaffected by whether an NEFU ICP is present, so that the FTSS software behaves the same either way.
technical_task: Keep the FTSS software and its ICP load identical whether or not an NEFU ICP is present.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NEFU ICP is present, when the FTSS software runs, then the FTSS ICP load is the same as without it.
Given no NEFU ICP is present, when the FTSS software runs, then the FTSS ICP load is the same as with it.

requirement_text: Customers shall cancel the billing process by card using the bill mode.
user_story: As a customer, I want to cancel the billing process by card through the bill mode, so that I can stop a payment.
technical_task: Provide a cancel option for the card billing process in the bill mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given the billing process by card is running in bill mode, when the customer cancels, then the process is stopped.
Given a cancelled billing process, when the customer reviews the bill, then no card payment is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an interpretation of cancelling.

requirement_text: The Long Range Radar is called "LRR" in the OEM communication specification ("[K-Matrix]").
rationale: The sentence states a name used in a specification and no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a naming note for the OEM communication specification?
What must the system do with the name "LRR"?

requirement_text: System shall offer quick calling features with minimal response time.
rationale: "Quick" and "minimal response time" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: How fast must calling features respond, in measurable terms?

requirement_text: System shall provide high-quality images and clear quality video calling for an optimal user experience.
clarification_questions: What image resolution and video quality values define "high-quality" and "clear"?
How is an "optimal user experience" judged?

requirement_text: The OBC shall detect a Circuit Low fault, if the output current of pin R_U exceeds 3.5 ampere for longer than 20 milliseconds.
user_story: As a diagnostics engineer, I want the OBC to detect a Circuit Low fault when pin R_U output current exceeds 3.5 ampere for more than 20 milliseconds, so that overcurrent is reported.
technical_task: Detect a Circuit Low fault in the OBC when the output current of pin R_U is above 3.5 ampere for longer than 20 milliseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given the output current of pin R_U exceeds 3.5 ampere, when it lasts longer than 20 milliseconds, then the OBC detects a Circuit Low fault.
Given the output current of pin R_U exceeds 3.5 ampere, when it lasts no longer than 20 milliseconds, then no Circuit Low fault is detected.

requirement_text: User shall be able to delete transportation routes.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete transportation routes, so that I can remove ones I no longer need.
technical_task: Provide a delete function for transportation routes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transportation route, when the user deletes it, then the route is removed.
Given a deleted route, when the route list is viewed, then it is no longer listed.

requirement_text: For estimators the product shall be able to be operated in a repair facility during dirty and noisy conditions.
requirement_text_raw: For estimators  the product shall be able to be operated in a repair facility during dirty and noisy conditions.'
clarification_questions: What conditions count as "dirty and noisy" and which limits apply?
Which estimators and repair facility are meant?

requirement_text: The system shall be maintainable by highly professional maintainers, who are solely responsible for updating and adding new features.
user_story: As a system owner, I want the system maintainable by the maintainers who alone update it and add new features, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Design the system so that its dedicated maintainers can update it and add new features.
acceptance_criteria: Given a maintainer, when an update is needed, then the maintainer can update the system.
Given a maintainer, when a new feature is requested, then the maintainer can add it.
rationale: Role assumed: system owner. "Highly professional" is not measurable and is not tested.

requirement_text: Further details for the control measures of the HV components in case of an interlock event and the timing shall be designed according to the specification of the OEM.
rationale: The sentence only points to an external specification and gives no content.
clarification_questions: What control measures are required for the HV components in case of an interlock event?
What timing values apply, since the OEM specification is not included?

requirement_text: Requirement and change management shall be utilized during the development phase.
rationale: The sentence names a practice and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which requirement and change management process and tools are meant?
What must be produced and when during the development phase?

requirement_text: Agency user shall have a better understanding of file-level errors to streamline data submission processes.
user_story: As an agency user, I want a better understanding of file-level errors, so that data submission is smoother.
technical_task: Report file-level errors with explanations that help the user correct a submission.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file with errors, when it is submitted, then each file-level error is reported to the agency user.
Given a reported error, when the user reads it, then it explains what is wrong with the file.
rationale: Role stated: agency user. The second criterion is an interpretation of "better understanding".

requirement_text: The solution should present patient-originated data for use by care providers.
user_story: As a care provider, I want patient-originated data presented to me, so that I can use it in care.
technical_task: Display patient-originated data to care providers.
acceptance_criteria: Given patient-originated data, when a care provider opens a patient record, then the data is presented.
Given a user who is not a care provider, when the user opens the record, then the data is not presented.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to play or learn about Mahjong.
user_story: As a player, I want to play Mahjong or learn about it, so that I can enjoy or study the game.
technical_task: Offer a Mahjong game and learning content about Mahjong.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Mahjong option, when the user chooses to play, then a game is started.
Given the Mahjong option, when the user chooses to learn, then information about Mahjong is shown.

requirement_text: The percental load is calculated by dividing the actual Iv-current by the smallest available current limit (derating / thermal limit or client current limit).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the percental load computed from the actual Iv-current and the smallest current limit, so that load is reported consistently.
technical_task: Compute the percental load as the actual Iv-current divided by the smallest of the available current limits (derating / thermal limit or client current limit).
acceptance_criteria: Given the actual Iv-current and the available current limits, when the load is computed, then the smallest current limit is used as the divisor.
Given the actual Iv-current and the smallest current limit, when the load is computed, then the result is the actual Iv-current divided by that limit.

requirement_text: User shall have a link on the home page to a list of training options, for easy access.
user_story: As a user, I want a link on the home page to a list of training options, so that I can reach training easily.
technical_task: Add a home page link that leads to a list of training options.
acceptance_criteria: Given the home page, when it is displayed, then it has a link to the list of training options.
Given the link, when the user selects it, then the list of training options is shown.

requirement_text: The CBIT shall be executed at a 50 Hz rate, after all 50 Hz flight critical operations are complete.
requirement_text_raw: The CBIT shall (3.3.5.5) be executed at a 50 Hz rate, after all 50 Hz flight critical operations are complete.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the CBIT to run at 50 Hz after all 50 Hz flight critical operations finish, so that it does not disturb them.
technical_task: Schedule the CBIT at a 50 Hz rate so that it runs after the 50 Hz flight critical operations have completed.
acceptance_criteria: Given all 50 Hz flight critical operations are complete, when the next CBIT slot arrives, then the CBIT is executed.
Given the CBIT is scheduled, when its rate is measured, then it is 50 Hz.

requirement_text: THEN no passing sign shall be removed from TSA display content earliest 200 milliseconds before and no later than the EV is passing the sign.
user_story: As a driver, I want a passing sign kept in the TSA display content until the EV passes it, so that I see signs as long as they apply.
technical_task: Remove a passing sign from the TSA display content no earlier than 200 milliseconds before the EV passes it and no later than the time it passes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EV approaching a passing sign, when it is more than 200 milliseconds before the EV passes the sign, then the sign is still in the TSA display content.
Given the EV is passing the sign, when the sign is removed, then the removal is not later than the moment of passing.
rationale: Role assumed: driver. "THEN" at the start suggests an omitted condition; it is not invented.

requirement_text: Measures are in place to prevent the upload of unauthorized files (e.g. executable files).
requirement_text_raw: Measures are in place to prevent the upload of unauthorized files (e.g.  executable files).
user_story: As a security officer, I want uploads of unauthorized files such as executables prevented, so that harmful files stay out.
technical_task: Block the upload of unauthorized files, for example executable files.
acceptance_criteria: Given an executable file, when a user tries to upload it, then the upload is blocked.
Given an allowed file, when a user uploads it, then the upload is accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. Which types are authorized is not listed.

requirement_text: The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.
requirement_text_raw: The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds.  The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'
user_story: As a technician, I want the search for recycled parts to return results in under 15 seconds, so that I find parts quickly.
technical_task: Make the recycled parts search finish and return its results in under 15 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search for recycled parts, when it is submitted, then it takes no longer than 15 seconds.
Given a completed search, when results are returned, then they arrive in under 15 seconds.

requirement_text: The system shall empower end-users to manage their private data, including the option to delete their personal repository.
user_story: As an end user, I want to manage my private data including deleting my personal repository, so that I stay in control.
technical_task: Provide end users with functions to manage their private data, including deletion of their personal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given an end user, when the user opens the private data settings, then the user can manage their private data.
Given a personal repository, when the user chooses to delete it, then it is deleted.

requirement_text: After detection of tG the recharging thresholds of IP and IS have to be activated and realized as short as possible to assure fast follow-on ignitions.
rationale: "As short as possible" and "fast" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: How quickly must the recharging thresholds of IP and IS be activated, in measurable terms?

requirement_text: The system shall allow archivists to track file usage and provide access to unprocessed materials.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to track file usage and provide access to unprocessed materials, so that I can manage the collection.
technical_task: Offer file usage tracking and access to unprocessed materials for archivists.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file in use, when an archivist reviews usage, then the file usage is shown.
Given unprocessed materials, when an archivist requests access, then access is provided.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for other users, location-based stories, events, and more, with matched results displayed.
user_story: As a user, I want to search for other users, location-based stories, events and more and see matching results, so that I can find content.
technical_task: Provide a search across users, location-based stories, events and other content that displays the matched results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search term, when the user searches, then matching users, location-based stories and events are displayed.
Given a search term with no matches, when the user searches, then no results are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "And more" means other content types may exist but none is named.

requirement_text: Admin must not dismiss an engaged menu unless the customer requests it.
user_story: As a customer, I want an engaged menu to stay until I ask to dismiss it, so that an admin does not close it on me.
technical_task: Prevent an administrator from dismissing an engaged menu unless the customer requests it.
acceptance_criteria: Given an engaged menu, when the admin tries to dismiss it without a customer request, then the menu stays open.
Given an engaged menu, when the customer requests dismissal, then the menu is dismissed.

requirement_text: If the diagnostic service '' ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSEâ? with parameter value `` Close '' is received in extended diagnostic session the ADSE interface must be closed.
user_story: As a diagnostics engineer, I want the ADSE interface closed when the ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE service is received with the value Close in an extended diagnostic session, so that the interface is closed on request.
technical_task: Close the ADSE interface when the diagnostic service ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE is received with parameter value Close in the extended diagnostic session.
acceptance_criteria: Given an extended diagnostic session, when the service ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE is received with the value Close, then the ADSE interface is closed.
Given a different diagnostic session, when the service is received, then the requirement does not specify closing.
rationale: Role assumed: diagnostics engineer. The service name contains garbled characters in the source; it is read as ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE.

requirement_text: The CMCS shall autonomously monitor and respond to hardware issues, software crashes, resource limitations, errors, and communication failures.
user_story: As a system operator, I want the CMCS to monitor and respond to hardware issues, software crashes, resource limitations, errors and communication failures on its own, so that problems are handled without manual action.
technical_task: Have the CMCS automatically monitor for hardware issues, software crashes, resource limitations, errors and communication failures and respond to them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hardware issue or a software crash, when it occurs, then the CMCS detects it and responds without manual action.
Given a resource limitation, an error or a communication failure, when it occurs, then the CMCS detects it and responds without manual action.
rationale: Role assumed: system operator. The responses are not specified.

requirement_text: Customers shall view nearby restaurants within a specified distance.
user_story: As a customer, I want to see restaurants near me within a specified distance, so that I can choose where to eat.
technical_task: List nearby restaurants within a distance that the customer specifies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified distance, when the customer searches, then restaurants within that distance are shown.
Given a restaurant outside the specified distance, when the customer searches, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role stated: customer. The distance value is not given.

requirement_text: Patient: When an American infant is born or a foreigner requests medical care each is assigned a medical identification number and password.
requirement_text_raw: Patient: When an American infant is born or a foreigner requests medical care  each is assigned a medical identification number and password.
user_story: As a registrar, I want an American infant or a foreigner requesting medical care assigned a medical identification number and password, so that each can be identified.
technical_task: Assign a medical identification number and password when an American infant is born or a foreigner requests medical care.
acceptance_criteria: Given an American infant is born, when the patient record is created, then a medical identification number and password are assigned.
Given a foreigner requests medical care, when the patient record is created, then a medical identification number and password are assigned.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The source names the actor as Patient.

requirement_text: Profile updates shall be allowed at any time.
user_story: As a user, I want to update my profile whenever I choose, so that my details stay current.
technical_task: Allow profile updates without time restriction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user profile, when the user edits it at any time and saves, then the update is stored.
Given a saved update, when the profile is viewed, then the new details are shown.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to deliver presentations in various modes, including full-screen mode and slide sorter view.
user_story: As a presenter, I want to deliver presentations in full-screen mode and slide sorter view among other modes, so that I can present in the style that suits me.
technical_task: Support several presentation modes including full-screen mode and slide sorter view.
acceptance_criteria: Given a presentation, when the user chooses full-screen mode, then it is shown full screen.
Given a presentation, when the user chooses slide sorter view, then the slides are shown in the slide sorter view.

requirement_text: System shall be able to ensure that the time elapsed between a player making a move and other players updating the game state is under 5 seconds.
user_story: As a player, I want other players to see my move in under 5 seconds, so that the game stays in step.
technical_task: Update the game state of other players within less than 5 seconds of a player's move.
acceptance_criteria: Given a player makes a move, when the other players' game state is updated, then the time elapsed is under 5 seconds.
Given a move, when the elapsed time reaches 5 seconds, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: System shall be able to log the serial number and update the log file.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the serial number logged and the log file updated, so that records are kept.
technical_task: Log the serial number and update the log file.
acceptance_criteria: Given a serial number, when it is processed, then it is logged.
Given a logged serial number, when the log is saved, then the log file is updated.

requirement_text: User shall have confidence in the system's performance as it supports multiple users simultaneously.
clarification_questions: How many simultaneous users must the system support and what response time is expected?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to update access privilege rules.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want to update access privilege rules, so that permissions stay current.
technical_task: Provide a function to update the access privilege rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given the access privilege rules, when an authorized user changes a rule and saves, then the rule is updated.
Given an updated rule, when a user tries to access a resource, then the new rule applies.

requirement_text: User shall have a maximum of three attempts to enter the password, after which an email notification will be sent if there's an additional attempt.
user_story: As a user, I want three attempts to enter my password and an email notification if I try again, so that unauthorized tries are flagged.
technical_task: Allow at most three password attempts and send an email notification when a further attempt is made.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who entered a wrong password, when the number of attempts is within three, then the user can try again.
Given three attempts have been used, when an additional attempt is made, then an email notification is sent.

requirement_text: Izogn Administrator must be able to add new products to the website within 2 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: Izogn Administrator must be able to add new products to the website within 2 minutes.'
user_story: As an Izogn administrator, I want to add new products to the website within 2 minutes, so that the catalog stays fresh.
technical_task: Make adding a new product to the website achievable in at most 2 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new product, when the administrator adds it to the website, then the task takes no more than 2 minutes.
Given an added product, when the website is viewed, then the product is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall be accessible to individuals with disabilities and comply with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG).
user_story: As a user with a disability, I want the system to be accessible and follow accessibility standards such as WCAG, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Build the system to comply with accessibility standards, for example WCAG.
acceptance_criteria: Given an individual with a disability, when the individual uses the system, then it is accessible.
Given the accessibility standards such as WCAG, when the system is checked against them, then it complies.
rationale: Role assumed: user with a disability. Which WCAG level is meant is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall currently support cash payments, with future expansion for credit/debit cards.
user_story: As a customer, I want to pay in cash now, so that I can complete purchases while card payments are not yet available.
technical_task: Support cash payments in the current release and leave room for credit and debit card payments later.
acceptance_criteria: Given a purchase, when the customer chooses to pay, then cash payment is supported.
Given the system design, when card payments are added in future, then it can be extended for credit and debit cards.

requirement_text: User shall have access to a videophone feature.
user_story: As a user, I want a videophone feature, so that I can talk face to face.
technical_task: Offer a videophone feature to users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the videophone feature, when the user starts a call, then audio and video are connected.
Given a call in progress, when the user ends it, then the call stops.

requirement_text: The Software Quality Gate "Delivery" specifies the date of every Software and / or Hardware release where the contractor gives detailed information about the release to the client.
user_story: As a client, I want the Delivery quality gate to give the date of each software or hardware release, so that I get the release information on time.
technical_task: Specify the date of every software and hardware release at the Software Quality Gate "Delivery" and provide the contractor's detailed release information to the client.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software or hardware release, when the Delivery quality gate is planned, then the release date is specified.
Given the release, when it is delivered, then the contractor gives the client detailed information about it.

requirement_text: System shall allow users to filter content based on various criteria.
user_story: As a user, I want to filter content by different criteria, so that I see only what I need.
technical_task: Provide content filters that work on several criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given content, when the user applies a filter criterion, then only matching content is shown.
Given a filter, when the user clears it, then all content is shown again.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: System Initialization shall call an application initialization function to allow the application to (at least) create tasks, create communication sockets, initialize the vehicle mode, and initialize memory alignment allowance.
requirement_text_raw: System Initialization shall [SRS215] call an application initialization function to allow the application to (at least) create tasks, create communication sockets, initialize the vehicle mode, and initialize memory alignment allowance.
user_story: As a software developer, I want System Initialization to call an application initialization function, so that the application can set up what it needs.
technical_task: Invoke an application initialization function from System Initialization in which the application can create tasks, create communication sockets, initialize the vehicle mode and initialize memory alignment allowance.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is initializing, when System Initialization runs, then it calls an application initialization function.
Given the application initialization function, when it runs, then the application can create tasks and communication sockets and initialize the vehicle mode and memory alignment allowance.

requirement_text: The CBIT, at a minimum, shall include a "presence test" to ascertain that all FCP processors are synchronized and are at the same relative point in time in the current minor frame.
requirement_text_raw: The CBIT, at a minimum, shall (3.3.5.6) include a "presence test" to ascertain that all FCP processors are synchronized and are at the same relative point in time in the current minor frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the CBIT to include a presence test, so that I know all FCP processors are synchronized at the same relative point in the minor frame.
technical_task: Include in the CBIT at least a presence test that checks that all FCP processors are synchronized and at the same relative time in the current minor frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given the CBIT is executed, when it runs, then it includes a presence test.
Given the presence test, when it runs, then it verifies that all FCP processors are synchronized and at the same relative point in time in the current minor frame.
